headline: Iran must stop arming Houthis in Yemen, G7 says ahead of UN General Assembly
context: The G7 also condemns "in the strongest terms" Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, saying that the escalation in fighting in Yemen jeopardises global energy security.
